comparison.objective: Candidate mechanically attaches a rail; record holds a shelf against an irregular wall while copying the wall profile with a compass.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses latch insertion, telescoping, leveling, and screwdriver control; record coordinates shelf stabilization with continuous two-contact tracing and orientation control.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks a retained load-bearing installation; record checks measured scribe accuracy across stations, captured wall curvature, shelf stability, and safe compass placement.
comparison.reason: Bimanual long-part support is the only material commonality; profile transfer by continuous tracing tests a different capability. Candidate lacks numeric level, force, and deformation thresholds.
